$comment: Every custom property the shared stylesheets (styles/*.css) read and do not define, which a runtime must therefore emit for them to work (SC-002). Names only: each value is the implementation's, generated from design-foundations and its brand engine, and the stylesheets reach colour through these alone. A property marked optional has a fallback at every read. Drafted 09/10/2026 from the stylesheets Salt for Next.js shipped at 1472afdd.

groups.what: Colour roles. Each re-points under [data-theme='dark'], so no stylesheet carries a dark variant; a section's tone routes them into its own --salt-section-* properties (sections.css).

tokens.name: --color-surface
tokens.meaning: The page ground, and the surface tone's band.

tokens.name: --color-surface-alt
tokens.meaning: The companion band, the surface-alt tone.

tokens.name: --color-surface-inverse
tokens.meaning: The inverted band, the surface-inverse tone.

tokens.name: --color-brand
tokens.meaning: The brand fill: the primary button, and the icon in a grid or carousel card.

tokens.name: --color-brand-tint
tokens.meaning: The brand-tint tone's band.

tokens.name: --color-on-brand
tokens.meaning: Text on the brand fill.

tokens.name: --color-ink
tokens.meaning: Body text on the light tones and the page ground.

tokens.name: --color-ink-muted
tokens.meaning: De-emphasised text on the light tones and in the view bodies.

tokens.name: --color-ink-inverse
tokens.meaning: Body text on the inverted band, and the contra pole of the focus indicator.

tokens.name: --color-ink-muted-inverse
tokens.meaning: De-emphasised text on the inverted band.

tokens.name: --color-border
tokens.meaning: The hairline on the light tones and in the page chrome.

tokens.name: --color-border-inverse
tokens.meaning: The hairline on the inverted band.

tokens.name: --color-border-strong
tokens.meaning: A boundary that identifies a control (held to 3:1) on the light tones.

tokens.name: --color-border-strong-inverse
tokens.meaning: A control's boundary on the inverted band.

tokens.name: --color-focus
tokens.meaning: The focus ring.

groups.what: Text roles and weight rungs. A text role is a visual rank, not an element: a card title is heading-4 whatever its level.

tokens.meaning: The hero headline.
An h1 with no rule of its own (base.css).
An h2 with no rule of its own: a section heading (base.css).
An h3 with no rule of its own (base.css).
A minor heading: card, FAQ question, dialog and footer column titles, the wordmark, and h4 to h6.
The standfirst: a section intro and the hero's subheading.
Running text inside the page's landmarks (base.css).
Supporting text: showcase meta and footer links.
Controls and their labels: buttons, menu links, tabs, pagination, form labels.
A gallery caption.
The eyebrow over a heading.
A quotation: a testimonial and a rich-text blockquote.
A stat's figure.

tokens.name: --weight-regular
tokens.meaning: The weight an emphasis steps back down to.

tokens.name: --weight-semibold
tokens.meaning: A semibold emphasis inside a role.

tokens.name: --weight-bold
tokens.meaning: A bold emphasis inside a role: an author's name.

groups.what: Space rungs and the layout roles built on them.

tokens.name: --space-0
tokens.meaning: No space, as a rung.

tokens.name: --space-3
tokens.meaning: Space rung 3: under a footer column title.

tokens.name: --space-4
tokens.meaning: Space rung 4: gaps inside the case study view.

tokens.name: --space-8
tokens.meaning: Space rung 8: gaps between the case study view's parts.

tokens.name: --space-gutter
tokens.meaning: The page's inline gutter, on every band and on the header and footer.

tokens.name: --space-section-sm
tokens.meaning: A compact band's block space.

tokens.name: --space-section-md
tokens.meaning: The default band's block space.

tokens.name: --space-section-lg
tokens.meaning: A spacious band's block space, which the markup writes into --salt-section-space.

tokens.name: --space-card-media
tokens.meaning: A card's join between its media and its title.

tokens.name: --space-card-title
tokens.meaning: A card's join after its title, and between two meta lines.

tokens.name: --space-card-body
tokens.meaning: A card's join between its parts, where no closer join applies.

tokens.name: --space-card-row
tokens.meaning: The gap between rows in a grid of cards.

groups.what: Content widths: the band's measures, by data-width.

tokens.name: --container-2xl
tokens.meaning: The narrow measure: running text, a service's opening text.

tokens.name: --container-5xl
tokens.meaning: The default measure.

tokens.name: --container-7xl
tokens.meaning: The wide measure, and the header's and footer's.

groups.what: Corners, transparency and the focus ring's geometry.

tokens.name: --radius-sm
tokens.meaning: A small corner: tags, a post's image frame.

tokens.name: --radius-md
tokens.meaning: A control's corner: buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: --radius-lg
tokens.meaning: A card's and a dialog's corner.

tokens.name: --radius-full
tokens.meaning: A pill or a circle: chips and portraits.

tokens.name: --opacity-medium
tokens.meaning: A carousel control at the end of its track.

tokens.name: --opacity-heavy
tokens.meaning: A disabled button.

tokens.name: --scrim-subtle
tokens.meaning: The subtle scrim's alpha, which the markup writes into --salt-scrim-alpha.

tokens.name: --scrim-standard
tokens.meaning: The standard scrim's alpha, which the markup writes into --salt-scrim-alpha.

tokens.name: --scrim-strong
tokens.meaning: The strong scrim's alpha, which the markup writes into --salt-scrim-alpha.

tokens.name: --focus-ring-width
tokens.meaning: The focus ring's width; the keyline's spread is computed from it.

tokens.name: --focus-ring-offset
tokens.meaning: The gap between a control and its focus ring.

groups.what: Timing for the little motion there is, all of it behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

tokens.name: --duration-moderate
tokens.meaning: The menu icon's morph.

tokens.name: --ease-in-out
tokens.meaning: The menu icon's morph curve.

groups.what: Written on an element by the markup itself, from editor content or a section setting.

tokens.name: --salt-section-space
tokens.meaning: A band's block space: var(--space-section-<spacing>), absent when spacing is none.

tokens.name: --salt-scrim-alpha
tokens.meaning: The scrim's strength over a background image: var(--scrim-<strength>).

tokens.name: --salt-rating-fill
tokens.meaning: How much of a rating's five stars is filled, as a percentage.

tokens.name: --salt-case-study-view-aside-rows
tokens.meaning: How many of a case study band's rows its aside spans.

tokens.name: --salt-case-study-view-measure
tokens.meaning: A case study band's measure, when it sets one.

tokens.name: --salt-header-phone-menu
tokens.meaning: Without script, shows the phone menu: the noscript style in the document head sets it.
tokens.ref: contract/markup/page.json, the noscript style in the head

tokens.name: --salt-header-phone-burger
tokens.meaning: Without script, hides the burger: the noscript style in the document head sets it.
tokens.ref: contract/markup/page.json, the noscript style in the head

tokens.name: --salt-header-phone-wrap
tokens.meaning: Without script, lets the header row wrap: the noscript style in the document head sets it.
tokens.ref: contract/markup/page.json, the noscript style in the head

groups.what: Measured and written at run time by the implementation's script. Each read either has a fallback or sits where a missing value draws nothing wrong.

tokens.name: --header-height
tokens.meaning: The sticky header's height, on the root, so a sticky aside clears it.

tokens.name: --salt-consent-banner-size
tokens.meaning: The consent banner's height, on the root, so content can scroll clear of it.

tokens.name: --salt-drawer-toggle-block-start
tokens.meaning: Where the menu button sits, so the drawer's close button lands on it.

tokens.name: --salt-drawer-toggle-block-size
tokens.meaning: The menu button's height, for the drawer's close button.

tokens.name: --salt-drawer-toggle-inline-start
tokens.meaning: The menu button's inline start, for the drawer's close button.

tokens.name: --salt-drawer-toggle-inline-end
tokens.meaning: The menu button's inline end, for the drawer's close button.

tokens.name: --salt-drawer-toggle-inline-size
tokens.meaning: The menu button's width, for the drawer's close button.
